This is an unsent forwarding proposal, not evidence that anyone was contacted, the display was corrected, or collection became possible. The decision appropriately withholds collection confirmation: E02 distinguishes display readiness from successful deposit and compartment assignment; E03 records a failed deposit; E05 reports a still-null allocation and pending van-custody check. Advising the customer not to set off directly addresses E06. The attachment extraction supports the reported 08:00 capture time, and possible staleness and later availability are explicitly uncertain. The candidate's 'ready' state is not presented as physical pickup readiness. Actor-04 is a reasonable internal contact because it supplied the locker-event information in E03, and its authority is expressly unverified, but the proposal leaves the channel and handoff to the locker team unspecified. The proposed request is understandable but omits the essential shipment reference VEL-007-26 and locker Lark-12, both visible in E01. It also does not expressly request resolution of the pending custody check or make the prerequisite of successful deposit plus assigned compartment explicit in the forwarding request. These omissions reduce operational completeness without undermining the central decision. No urgent safety escalation or completed business action is warranted or claimed.
